company_name: Suzhou Sail Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ultra precision diamond and CBN tools specifically designed for semiconductor processing.
summary: Suzhou Sail Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech corporation focused on the research, development, production, and sales of ultra precision diamond and CBN tools for the semiconductor industry. Their products, including ultra-thin metal-bond dicing blades and diamond wheels, are widely utilized in various precision processing applications such as cutting, dicing, and wafering.
capabilities: Resin bonded and metal bonded diamond wheels
Precision tools for CMP and back-thinning

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Suzhou Industrial Park, indicating a strong presence in the Chinese semiconductor market.
